item.title: 'You're going to jail': Video shows Olympic track star Sha'Carri Richardson's 'super speeder' arrest in Florida
item.description: Body camera video released Friday shows a deputy pulling over Olympic track star Sha’Carri Richardson before she was arrested on Florida's 'super speeder" law.

item.title: NASA Glenn playing vital role in Artemis moon mission
item.description: Americans first walked on the moon on July 20, 1969. But before Neil Armstrong made that first step, it took thousands of scientists and engineers to put him there, and a whole bunch of them were right in Northeast Ohio.

item.title: Rescuers search frigid Atlantic for missing fishermen after boat sinks
item.description: There wasn't a mayday call from the commercial fishing vessel Lily Jean as it navigated the frigid Atlantic Ocean Friday morning on its way home to Gloucester.

item.title: DeWine postpones executions for 3 death row inmates, including Danny Lee Hill
item.description: Ohio Governor Mike DeWine has postponed the executions of three more inmates on death row, including the man convicted of killing a 12-year-old boy in Northeast Ohio more than four decades ago.

item.title: Local emergency rooms seeing increase in weather-related cases amid dangerous cold

item.title: Snowy, cold pattern could last into March: FOX 8 rest-of-winter outlook
item.description: Northeast Ohio should brace for a colder-than-normal and snowier finish to winter, according to FOX 8 meteorologist Scott Sabol, who says the region is locked into a persistent storm pattern that could last into March.
